ai_summary: Here is the executive summary:  Apollo Micro Systems Limited (AMS) has been empanelled by the Indian Air Force as a Prime Development Agency for the Indigenous Precision Range Extension Kit (IPREK) program, marking a strategic entry into India's high-value precision guided munition segment and aiming to reduce import dependency. While this represents a significant multi-year revenue opportunity and strong endorsement of AMS's indigenous capabilities, it is crucial to note that this empanelment does not constitute a firm order or commercial contract, with revenue generation contingent on future formal project sanction and procurement.
